name: Camera Vision
author: Ava
description: On-device camera with QR, EAN/UPC barcode, face, and hand gesture detection. Live camera entity plus sensors in Home Assistant.
detail_description: Owns the device camera and exposes it as a Home Assistant camera entity with selectable front/back lens, FPS, resolution, and JPEG quality. Runs YuNet face detection (recognises faces down to ~10px, far beyond BlazeFace, with legacy BlazeFace models still selectable), ZXing QR and retail barcode decode (EAN-13/EAN-8/UPC-A/UPC-E on their own Last Barcode entity — scan groceries into shopping-list automations), and BlazePalm + Hand Landmark Lite open-palm gesture recognition. Every sensor is ON out of the box and each has its own switch in Home Assistant and in mod settings, so you can turn off anything you do not want. Screensaver Person Wake hooks face detection into Ava's screensaver: walk up and it dismisses, stay and it will not return, walk away and the idle countdown resumes — more reliable than the built-in brightness-difference probe it replaces. Detection runs on a separate thread from capture so the live view stays smooth, and models use XNNPACK acceleration. The stream heals itself: a dead stream is detected and reopened automatically, a camera that keeps failing falls back to the next available lens (and returns when the preferred one recovers), and Adaptive Quality drops resolution one step while the stream stutters then climbs back once it is stable — all visible on the Stream Health sensor.

config.label: Enable Camera
config.description: Open the device camera and publish frames to the Home Assistant camera entity.

config.label: Use Front Camera
config.description: On = front/selfie lens, Off = rear lens. Restarts the camera when changed.

config.label: Frame Rate
config.description: Capture FPS. 5 is plenty for detection; higher costs CPU and heat on wall panels.

config.label: Resolution (short edge)
config.description: 240-720 safe for all devices. 1080 needs capable hardware. Restarts the camera.

config.label: Frame Rotation
config.description: Auto straightens the image using the camera sensor. Face and hand models only recognise upright subjects, so set this manually if the preview is sideways or upside down.

config.label: Adaptive Quality
config.description: Drop resolution one step while the stream stutters and climb back once it is stable. Dead streams are restarted automatically and a failing camera falls back to the next available lens either way.

config.label: JPEG Quality
config.description: Image quality for the camera entity. Higher looks better but uses more bandwidth.

config.label: Face Detection
config.description: YuNet face detection: recognises faces down to ~10px, so people register from across the room.

config.label: Face Model
config.description: yunet = best range and small-face accuracy (recommended). sparse/short = legacy BlazeFace 5m/2m models.

config.label: Screensaver Person Wake
config.description: Dismiss the screensaver when a face is detected and keep it away while someone is present. Replaces Ava's built-in person-wake with real face detection. Needs Face Detection on.

config.label: Gesture Detection
config.description: Palm + 21-point hand landmark: reports open palm and finger count.

config.label: QR Detection
config.description: Decode QR codes from camera frames. Exposes content and HA tag IDs.

config.label: Barcode Detection
config.description: Decode retail product barcodes (EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E) onto the Last Barcode entity. Hold codes horizontally for best results.

config.label: QR Cooldown (seconds)
config.description: Minimum seconds before reporting the same QR code again

config.label: Parse HA Tag URLs
config.description: Extract tag ID from home-assistant.io/tag/ URLs
